name: Fairway Ranger

primary.name: Fairway Drive
primary.description: Drive a small golf ball for 30 damage. Aim down the fairway; obstacles stop the ball.

secondary.name: Chip Shot
secondary.description: Hold to aim a charged golf ball. A wider 125-radius landing blast releases six 50-radius fragments.

special.name: Course Ricochet
special.description: Strike one golf ball that ricochets between up to five different enemies, dealing 20% less damage with each hit.

passive: Calm Focus: recover 4 health after defeating an enemy.

technique.name: Fairway Reach
technique.description: Ricochet between targets 40% farther apart, for 20% less damage.

final_technique.name: Hook and Slice
final_technique.description: Send a hook and slice around opposite sides before returning. Each foe takes at most 11 on each leg. Wider control, slower firing.

attack.name: Hook and Slice
attack.description: Send a hook and slice around opposite sides before returning. Each foe takes at most 11 on each leg. Wider control, slower firing.
